ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a transition-state organic structure. On the right there is an explicit aryl ring, and on the left there are two aryl substituent labels, Ar¹ attached near nitrogen and Ar attached at the lower-left carbon. The small central core contains N and O atoms connected through heavy-atom bonds, with curved arrows and charge marks drawn; these arrows and charge marks are not counted as bonds. Reasoning: Count the heavy-atom bonds only, excluding any bonds to hydrogen. There are three aryl components total: the explicit aryl ring on the right, the Ar¹ group, and the Ar group. Each aryl ring contributes 6 ring bonds, so the aryl-ring contribution is 3 × 6 = 18 bonds. The non-ring heavy-atom connections shown are Ar¹–N, N–central carbon, central carbon–right aryl ring, central carbon–O, O–left carbon, and left carbon–Ar, giving 6 additional bonds. Total = 18 + 6 = 24.
